Hi Aisha / team -

Thanks for the helpful context. A few clarifying questions from the security side to make the kickoff productive: 

1) Data sensitivity: you mentioned de-identified patient summaries initially. Can you confirm whether any PII/PHI will be included in the test payloads? If PHI may be included later, we'll need to discuss BAA terms and data handling controls.
2) Data flow and retention: will data be sent to Redwood's hosted API or do you plan to use a dedicated/private deployment? If hosted, what retention policy do you require for logs and generated content? Our default is ephemeral model inputs cached for up to 7 days for debugging unless configured otherwise.
3) Authentication & secrets: will API keys be managed by your team or via a customer-managed KMS/HSM? Any requirement that keys not leave your network?
4) Network scope: can you confirm public IP ranges or whether a private peering/VPC option is required? 

Proposed kickoff agenda (30-45m):
- Introductions & stakeholder roles (5m)
- High-level architecture & data flow (10m)
- Questionnaire walk-through (10m)
- Open technical Q&A + next steps (10-20m)

If you can share the filled questionnaire ahead of the meeting, I'll pre-annotate items and surface any blockers. Otherwise we'll walk through it together.

Thanks - I'll wait for the filled doc and confirm the calendar invite once Neha sends it.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Security & Privacy Manager
Redwood Inference
